thresholdPolicy.status: method-frozen; no candidate measured; pilot is not a release threshold
thresholdPolicy.latency: After at least 30 valid reference runs per scenario/machine/mode, ceiling = max(reference p95 * 1.20, reference p95 + 16.7ms). Freeze numeric values and raw capture SHA before the first candidate measurement.
thresholdPolicy.throughput: Use identical deterministic 1000-chunk fixture timing and payload; floor = reference median * 0.90. Freeze bytes/s and wall-time limits before candidate measurement.
thresholdPolicy.resources: Run 1000 turns plus background-task cleanup; ceiling = reference p95 process-tree RSS * 1.20. Growth above post-warmup baseline must not exceed max(reference growth * 1.20, 16MiB). Freeze per platform.
thresholdPolicy.comparison: Same installed-product hardware/OS/PTY dimensions, fixture, environment, power state and cache policy; alternate reference/candidate run order. Invalid runs remain recorded, not silently discarded.
thresholdPolicy.invalidation: Any fixture, terminal-driver, hardware or reference change requires new reference measurements and reviewed numeric thresholds before candidate runs.
